mapper.select: SELECT CAST(userId AS UNSIGNED) AS id, userId AS username, password, userId AS phone, userName AS nickname, IF(userSex = 1, '男', '女') AS gender, userImg AS avatar, IF(delTag = 1, 'ACTIVE', 'DELETED') AS status FROM `user` WHERE userId = #{username} LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(userId AS UNSIGNED) AS id, userId AS username, password, userId AS phone, userName AS nickname, IF(userSex = 1, '男', '女') AS gender, userImg AS avatar, IF(delTag = 1, 'ACTIVE', 'DELETED') AS status FROM `user` WHERE userId = CAST(#{id} AS CHAR) LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `user` (userId, password, userName, userSex, userImg, delTag) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, IF(#{gender} = '女', 0, 1), #{avatar}, 1)
